title: Data Element Validation Readiness
description: Prepare for EDD's annual Data Element Validation. Covers the sampling process, the 15-business-day document window, source-document requirements (WSD22-15), the 10 percent error threshold, and a self-audit routine staff can run monthly.
notes: Audience: MIS Administrators, supervisors, case managers. Format: LV. Hours assumed from format (LV = 3 hours). Gap addressed: TEGL 23-19 Change 3 requires annual validation training; current state training covers it in one webinar.
learning_objectives: Explain how DEV samples files and scores elements.
Match each commonly failed element to its acceptable source documents.
Run a monthly file self-audit using a CCC checklist.
Correct errors through the proper Data Change Request process before the annual report.
prerequisites: FND 103 (IEPs and Case Notes That Survive Validation) recommended

sequencing_rationale: Lessons follow the catalog's learning objectives in the order a practitioner meets them on the job: How DEV Samples and Scores; Source Documents for Commonly Failed Elements; The Monthly Self-Audit; Correcting Errors Through Data Change Requests. The closing project ("Project: Self-Audit a Sample File Set") applies the earlier lessons to one realistic work product (a completed self-audit of sample files that matches elements to source documents and routes corrections through a Data Change Request) rather than introducing new content. Scope assumptions: hours are not stated in the source catalog and are assumed from the delivery format (LV; LV = 3 hours). Content is grounded in California and federal guidance named in the catalog description and objectives; the course cites those directives by number but does not reproduce their text, and every policy-specific claim must be checked against the current directive before delivery. Local board policy is treated as a variable the learner fills in from their own board, not something the course prescribes. Design driver (catalog "gap addressed"): TEGL 23-19 Change 3 requires annual validation training; current state training covers it in one webinar. Statistics and audit findings quoted from the catalog have not been independently verified. Prerequisites reflect track order: FND 103 (IEPs and Case Notes That Survive Validation) recommended.
